projects.name: NEAR Lab — Attention-Aware AI
details: Developed a multimodal AI pipeline integrating **Eye Tracking, Computer Vision, and GPT-4.1** for attention-aware reasoning.
Implemented **Gaze Mapping, AOI Extraction, Gaussian Heatmaps, and Pixel-Level Alignment** to analyze visual attention.

publication.label: Measuring Visual Attention Across Concurrent and Sequential Visual Perception Tasks

projects.name: BAT Lab — Smart Wheelchair Haptic Feedback
details: Developed a **C#-based haptic feedback system** with 12 vibration actuators, supporting directional and urgency-based alerts.
Implemented frame-based stimulation control and reaction-time logging for experimental analysis.

publication.label: Evaluating an AI-enhanced power wheelchair obstacle alert system: Effects of multimodal warning design on warning-response behavior

projects.name: Embodied AI — Robotic Arm Simulation
details: Built robotic arm simulations using **NVIDIA Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, and Python**.
Implemented joint control, waypoint-based manipulation, and motion trajectory logging.
